Point of No Return#000.src: Live well, {u}. That is all I ask.

Point of No Return#001.src: Retrace the steps of your soul to keep up...

Point of No Return#004.src: Holding the Soul Retainer seems to switch your location with your soul...

Point of No Return#007.src: You... could it be...? Are you... real?
Point of No Return#007.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#008.src: Ha... ha... you should not have come here.
Point of No Return#008.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#009.src: Have you seen the others? Barely clinging on to life... hollowed, empty.
Point of No Return#009.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#010.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#010.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#011.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#011.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#022.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#022.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#023.src: An beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#023.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#024.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#024.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#025.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#025.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#026.src: Don't be fooled - everything you see around you is very real.
Point of No Return#026.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#031.src: You look different in the mirror. It is a reflection of your inner self.

Point of No Return#033.src: Something must be left behind. And you must leave.

Point of No Return#034.src: ...more than anything beyond, at least. The Obelisk protects us, after all.
Point of No Return#034.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#035.src: Do you feel its pull? It calls to us all, when we arrive.
Point of No Return#035.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#036.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#036.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#037.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#037.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#038.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#038.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#039.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#039.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#043.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#043.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#044.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.

Point of No Return#045.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#045.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#046.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#046.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#047.src: The others... all have given into its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#047.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#048.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#048.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#049.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#049.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#050.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#050.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#051.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#051.speaker: Lutho Citizen
